# Fere AI Documentation

> Official docs for Fere AI — AI trading agents that each run a unique strategy, agent wallets, the Fere MCP for research and trading, and points.

Product context for AI crawlers also lives at: https://www.fereai.xyz/llms.txt

## Get Started

- [Welcome](https://docs.fereai.xyz/): Pick an agent, fund it, and it trades — or research and trade from your own AI with the Fere MCP.

## Agents

- [Agents](https://docs.fereai.xyz/agents): The agents catalogue, how backtests are run and annualized, starting and funding an agent, settings, skipped buys held in Cash and retried daily when no fair price is available, stopping, withdrawing, and fees.
- [Wallet & Security](https://docs.fereai.xyz/wallet): Agent wallets, Cash in US dollars, dust and unverified tokens, MCP wallets, and Coinbase CDP security.
- [On Your Phone](https://docs.fereai.xyz/phone): The phone layout on the web and in the iOS app: Portfolio, Agents and Activity tabs, the account menu, the Fere Wallet screen, an agent's page, and Hide balances.

## Research & Trading via MCP

- [MCP Support](https://docs.fereai.xyz/mcp): Research and trade with Fere from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw, and other MCP clients.
- [Agent API auth](https://docs.fereai.xyz/api-auth): AgentDoor errors `client_blocked` (403, stop and change User-Agent), `rate_limited` (429, wait for Retry-After), and `agent_inactive` (401 on token use, 403 on verify; stop retrying).
- [Rate limits](https://docs.fereai.xyz/rate-limits): Signed-in API requests are limited per account (default 600 per minute, shared by every token). On 429 `rate_limited`, wait `Retry-After` seconds, then retry once. Wallet reads (holdings, PnL history, venue summary) also have per-account budgets per minute, per hour and in flight; their 429 names the `budget` and `window`. An account can run 5 schedules at once (agents from the catalogue don't count): 409 `schedule_limit_reached` means stop one first, 402 `insufficient_credits` means top up first.

## Rewards

- [Points & Leaderboard](https://docs.fereai.xyz/points): Points from on-chain trading volume, with a weekly leaderboard.
- [Refer & Earn](https://docs.fereai.xyz/refer-and-earn): New fee-share referral program with tiers — coming soon.

## Help & Legal

- [FAQ](https://docs.fereai.xyz/faq): Agents, funding and withdrawing, fees, wallet security, the MCP, points, and how public share pages are indexed.
- [Share pages](https://docs.fereai.xyz/share-pages): Public `/share/{id}/{slug}` pages, the question slug, thin-answer noindex, and the automated research feed (off unless ops enables it).
- [Support](https://docs.fereai.xyz/support): Email aron@fereai.xyz or DM @0xAron on X — including custom agents and deploying your own strategy.
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/terms): Terms of Use for the FereAI service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/privacy): GDPR-aligned privacy practices.
- [Security Policy](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/security-policy): Responsible vulnerability disclosure.
